(rule!
  (let ((after-rows
         (for/fold ([out g]) ([r (in-range (rows g))])
           (let ((cols1 (filter (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 1)) (range 0 (cols g)))))
             (if (and (= (length cols1) 2)
                      (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 0)) (range (+ (first cols1) 1) (second cols1))))
                 (paint-cells out (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) (range (+ (first cols1) 1) (second cols1))) 3)
                 out)))))
    (for/fold ([out after-rows]) ([c (in-range (cols g))])
      (let ((rows1 (filter (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 1)) (range 0 (rows g)))))
        (if (and (= (length rows1) 2)
                 (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 0)) (range (+ (first rows1) 1) (second rows1))))
            (paint-cells out (map (lambda (r) (list r c)) (range (+ (first rows1) 1) (second rows1))) 3)
            out)))))
